content_blocks.text: Media News & Press Release Events Blogs
Monitor, analyse, and optimise facility performance with AI, machine learning, and +IoT across India, the Middle East, and Africa.

Sterling & Wilson Data Center Smart Operations helps organisations move from reactive monitoring to intelligent, data-driven operations.Powered by SmartSense, an AI-based monitoring platform delivered by Sterling & Wilson Data Center in partnership with Ecolibrium, the solution provides real-time visibility into critical assets, energy consumption, equipment health, and carbon footprint.This enables organizations to identify anomalies, predict potential failures before they occur, improve operational efficiency, reduce downtime, and make faster, data-driven decisions across multiple facilities.
Smart Operations brings together analytics, AI, machine learning, and IoT to improve how critical infrastructure is monitored and managed.
Monitor power and cooling performance in real time.
Track and manage carbon emissions and impact
Gain real time visibility across assets and operation
Detect anomalies earlyand take action faster
Predict failures and plan maintainance in advance
Identify patterns and predict failures before they affect operations. Reduce unplanned downtime, extend asset life, and improve maintenance planning.
Gain live visibility across critical infrastructure through centralised dashboards and automated alerts.
Track consumption patterns, identify inefficiencies, and improve resource performance across sites.
Monitor asset condition continuously and detect early signs of abnormal performance.
Measure and monitor carbon impact with clearer sustainability insights and reporting.
Use data-driven insights to identify issues faster and improve decision-making at site and portfolio level.
Improve uptime, monitor critical assets, and optimise infrastructure performance inmission-critical environments.
Track distributed assets for manned & unmanned sites, monitor site health remotely, and gain visibility across wide-area operations.
Improve facility efficiency, manage energy use, and centralise performancemonitoring across building portfolios.
Monitor equipment health, reduce downtime, and support smarter plant operations through predictive intelligence.
Gain multi-site visibility, standardise performance, and improve operationalconsistency across locations.

Track facility health in real time
Centralised visibility across assets and sites
Focus on efficiency, uptime, and sustainability

Defect Liability Period (DLP) [12 months] – bank guarantee, incident management, and transition to O&M.
Operations & Maintenance (O&M) [36-60 months] – Resource allocation, structured L1-L3 incident management, and long-term infrastructure optimization.
Contract Award – LoA issuance, detailed contract signing, branch/subsidiary formation, BG submission, and insurance processing.
Detailed Design & Engineering – Design validation, detailed engineering, software-based modeling, client approvals, regulatory compliance, value engineering & product optimization.
Procurement – Vendor evaluation, technical compliance checks, competitive global sourcing, vendor selection via reverse auction, and commercial negotiations.
Construction (Site Infra Build) – Civil work, substructure, superstructure, facades, fenestrations, and interiors.
MEP Implementation – Electrical, HVAC, ELV, fire fighting, plumbing, structured cabling.
Testing & Commissioning – Third-party agency appointment, script development, sequence of operation (SOO), L1-L5 testing, ISAT, and RFS (Ready for Service).
Marketing Activities [3 months] – Market identification, customer segmentation, enquiry sourcing, networking & events, referrals, and media outreach.
Pre-Bidding [1 month] – Client due diligence, commercial & financial terms, technical scope identification, risk analysis, migration strategy, PQ activities (client registration), go/no-go decision.
Bidding [1-2 months] – Contract evaluation, technical & execution strategy, value engineering, sourcing plans, project planning, pricing & bid proposal preparation.
Contract Negotiation [2 months] – Finalizing technical, commercial, and execution terms, contract duration, and client expectations.

What is a Smart Operations platform?
A Smart Operations platform uses AI, machine learning, analytics, and IoT to monitor critical infrastructure, predict issues, and improve operational performance.
Which industries can benefit from Smart Operations?
Data centres, Telecom towers, Commercial buildings, Hospitals, Connected factories, Large campuses and retail chains can all benefit from better monitoring and predictive intelligence.
